tagline: The questionable logic of ordinary life, deconstructed.
subject: Amit Tandon

currentShow.title: Aise Kaise
currentShow.theme: Changing times, domestic rituals, and the questionable logic behind how friends, family, and Amit himself behave.

gyanBites.quote: 18°C is Arctic tundra, 24°C is Sahara desert, 22°C is a pending court case.
gyanBites.observation: Every Indian bedroom hosts a midnight UN summit. The blankets are the only neutral territory.

gyanBites.quote: You pay ₹4 lakh annual private school fees, hire IB tutors, buy MacBook Pros... so they can reply 'bruh' to your earnest life advice.
gyanBites.observation: Cost per syllable spoken by a 16-year-old: ₹2,00,000.

gyanBites.quote: “Bas 5 minute mein tayar ho rahi hoon!” violates Einstein's theory of general relativity. NASA should study Indian women's time dilation.
gyanBites.observation: 5 minutes in domestic marriage time is roughly 1 hour 45 minutes in civilian time.

corporate.title: Corporate Keynotes & Private Galas
corporate.bio: An engineering graduate with an MBA from IIT Delhi and a decade of corporate entrepreneurship running recruitment enterprises, Amit Tandon bridges boardroom wit with relatable storytelling.
bullets: Customized sets for leadership retreats, global CXO summits, and annual galas
Strictly 100% clean, inclusive humor safe for multi-tiered corporate audiences
Trusted by Fortune 500 multinationals and leading industry associations worldwide

about.short: Observational Hindi stand-up comedian known for clean, universal humor deconstructing marriage, parenting, middle-class upgrades, and human contradictions.
about.journeyLine: Mechanical Engineer → IIT Delhi MBA → Corporate Entrepreneur → Global Touring Comedian.
